title: Disclosure of fees.
bodyText: All fees and commissions charged by a trust company to its clients or the manner by which fees and commissions shall be determined shall be disclosed in writing prior to rendering the services for which the fees or commissions are charged.
bodyHtml: §412:8-403  Disclosure of fees.  All fees and commissions charged by a trust company to its clients or the manner by which fees and commissions shall be determined shall be disclosed in writing prior to rendering the services for which the fees or commissions are charged. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
